slides.myth: My notary commission is good for life.
slides.fact: Commissions run for a set term. Renewal isn't automatic.

slides.myth: The stamp date passed last week. One more signing is fine.
slides.fact: An expired commission generally means no notarizing until you renew.

slides.myth: My bond and E&O policy renew on the same day.
slides.fact: They can run on separate terms. Write each date down.
